about: UtilityNav — a short row of small links above or beside the primary navigation. The things a reader looks for on every page but that are not what the site is about: contact, careers, a customer portal

links.about: The few links every page carries that are not the site's sections: contact, careers, a portal, log in.

label.about: The landmark's name, so it is told apart from the primary navigation.

align.about: Which edge the row keeps to. End by default, out of the way of the brand.

end.about: After the links: an account name and Sign out, or a language switch.
